tasks.spec: Execute a bounded fleet-resolution wave from Aegis with Talaris reachable as ssh talaris. Produce exactly these task-directory artifacts: resolution-report.md, restart-gate.json, ledger-repair.json, handoff-repair.json, paperclip-adjudication.json, and changes.patch. Never print, copy, or persist credentials. Begin with fresh live evidence, not inherited PIDs: query Ringside /api/runs, independently verify every reported PID with ps, query Paperclip health/company live runs/issue runs/agent roster, and record UTC timestamps. RESTART SAFETY: do not kill/cancel any process or run, restart/reboot any host/service, pause/resume a dispatcher or agent, mutate a Paperclip issue, or declare GO while any genuine Ringer process/run, Paperclip live run, or recent executing heartbeat exists. restart-gate.json must contain checked_at, verdict (HOLD or GO), ringside_active, process_evidence, paperclip_live_runs, recent_heartbeats, dispatcher_state, blockers, required_next_observation, and falsifier. GO requires two observations 60-120 seconds apart proving all execution sets empty; otherwise HOLD. LEDGER REPAIR: canonical repo is /Users/jack.reis/Documents/=notes on Talaris. Inspect current HEAD, dirty state, commit feed18a2, current ledger code, tests, wrappers, and ~/.hermes/ledger/current. Never edit the canonical checkout. Create an isolated temporary git worktree from current HEAD, restore/review fleet_health.py and its tests from feed18a2, restore/refactor atomic same-filesystem generation publication without overwriting unrelated current accounting changes, make run-ai-usage-ledger.sh forward arguments, and add/adjust tests for atomic pointer swap, manifest hashes, failure boundaries, concurrency/locking, retention, stale temp handling, and compatibility links as warranted by current code. Run focused tests and the full relevant ledger suite. Do not publish a production generation and do not merge/cherry-pick. Export the path-scoped diff to changes.patch in the task directory. ledger-repair.json must contain canonical_head, isolated_worktree, files_changed, tests with commands/exit codes, publication_performed false as a JSON boolean, current_pointer_before, current_pointer_after, rollback, residual_risks, and verdict. The current pointer must remain byte-for-byte unchanged. HANDOFF REPAIR: inspect the latest 25 handoff entries and full fleet inbox on Talaris. In the same isolated worktree, implement only if a clear existing coordination-tool seam exists: validation/atomic pointer update that rejects auto-generated stubs, stale candidates, broken targets, and concurrent regression, plus tests and a machine-readable latest-substantive/latest-stub/latest-by-lane index. If no safe existing seam exists, make no speculative code change and instead document exact proposed file/API/tests. Never repoint LATEST_HANDOFF.md during this wave. handoff-repair.json must record evidence, implementation_status, files_changed, tests, pointer_before, pointer_after, rollback, and residual_risks; pointer_before must equal pointer_after. PAPERCLIP: diagnose Operator and Coder errors plus Analyst-Opus, Fable, Pi Campaign Auditor, and Analyst-Sonnet pauses using current run, heartbeat, adapter/provider, and assignment evidence. Read-only only; do not canary, comment, assign, resume, pause, or clear state. paperclip-adjudication.json must contain checked_at and an agents object keyed exactly by these display names: Operator, Coder, Analyst-Opus, Fable, Pi Campaign Auditor, Analyst-Sonnet. Each value must be an object containing id, observed_status, latest_run, latest_heartbeat, evidence, classification, recommended_canary, rollback, and owner. HUMAN GATES: Prius work and rogue-artifact salvage/archive/discard are excluded; preserve custody and perform no vendor contact, booking, tow, purchase, merge, cleanup, deployment, or deletion. resolution-report.md must summarize executed work, exact evidence, tests, blockers, safe next action, rollback instructions, and a definition-of-done checklist. It must clearly distinguish completed, prepared-not-deployed, blocked, and human-gated. Preserve all canonical dirty work and forensic receipts. Do not use rm, git reset, git checkout on the canonical tree, broad git add, force operations, or destructive cleanup.
tasks.verified: Fresh live restart evidence, isolated tested repair patch, handoff authority assessment, and per-agent Paperclip adjudication were produced without restart, publication, pointer mutation, destructive cleanup, or human-gated action.
